near_miss_rationale.what is Form 16 and who issues it: Mentions a document the description lists, but asks for a definition, not for filing help. Firing here means the description is keyed on nouns rather than on intent.
near_miss_rationale.draft a reply to an income tax scrutiny: Income tax, but assessment proceedings — explicitly out of scope and an escalate case.
near_miss_rationale.what's the TDS rate on a contractor paym: Indian income tax, but a deductor question, not a return-filing one.
near_miss_rationale.parse this JSON file and tell me what fi: A generic parsing request. The skill reads two specific portal documents; firing on the word JSON means the description is keyed on a file format.
near_miss_rationale.what does carry forward of losses mean i: Conceptual and not jurisdiction-specific. No return is being prepared.
near_miss_rationale.open this password protected PDF for me: The skill can do this, but only as a step in filing. Firing here would make it a general-purpose PDF tool, which it is not.
near_miss_rationale.reconcile my bank statement against my a: Bookkeeping, not a return. The word reconcile is not the trigger; a return being prepared is.
